description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding/Agreement between Sri Lankan Universities and Foreign Universities for the purpose of Educational Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It has been recognized that establishing higher educational cooperation with foreign universities is essential for elevating Sri Lankan universities in world ranking indicators and internationalization. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education, and Vocational Education to enter into the following Memoranda of Understanding/Agreement between universities in Sri Lanka and foreign universities, was approved by the Cabinet:

The Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo of Sri Lanka and the Manipal Academy of Higher Education of India with the objectives of enhancing educational cooperation, exchanging material relating to publications and academic information, exchanging academic staff, research scholars and students and obtaining technical assistance.


The Memorandum of Understanding between the Buddhist and Pali University of Sri Lanka and the Mahamakut Buddhist University of Thailand on Academic and Research Collaboration.


The Memorandum of Understanding among the University of Moratuwa of Sri Lanka, Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University of China and the Universitat La Salle, Barcelona of Spain on Research Collaboration.


The Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Peradeniya of Sri Lanka and the Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology, the Commonwealth of Australia regarding the conduct of collaborative research training programmes, carrying out activities related to submitting publications and research cooperation, and the Umbrella Cotutelle Agreement between the two parties concerning the implementation of collaborative research training programmes and awarding postgraduate study programmes.
